steps.text: EN PASSANT is French for 'in passing' — a special pawn capture! If an enemy pawn zooms past your pawn with a two-square move, you can capture it as if it had only moved one square. But you must do it right away, on your very next move!

steps.prompt: Black's pawn just zoomed past yours! Capture it en passant — move your pawn to d6.
steps.successText: En passant! You captured a pawn that wasn't even on that square!
steps.retryText: Capture 'in passing' by moving your pawn diagonally to d6.

steps.prompt: Try it again! Capture the pawn that just rushed past on the other side — go to f6.
steps.successText: Another en passant capture — you're getting the hang of it!
steps.retryText: Capture 'in passing' by moving your pawn diagonally to f6.

steps.text: Remember: you can only capture en passant on the very next move — if you wait, the chance is gone forever!
Next: what happens when a pawn makes it all the way to the other end of the board?
